Body butter, scrubs, bath bars and sleep rituals

Pick up a body butter, scrub, bath bar or pillow spray from our 50 bath and body products, with prices from £6.99. The range mixes Indian natural care from Deyga and Vilvah with luxury English formulas from Highborn London and calming sleep products from anatomē. Every item is authentic and posted from the UK.

Wash, scrub and moisturise

Deyga bath bars come in Spinach & Cucumber, Rose Pink Clay, Shea Saffron and Neem & Turmeric, and each bath bar costs £15.99 or less. Our Swansura Selection goat milk soap range includes Classic Goatmilk and Classic Rose bars at £9.99. Follow with Deyga Body Scrub, a body scrub at £16.99 made with papaya and pomegranate, or Highborn London Natural Luminosity Scrub for a richer treat. Then seal in moisture with Deyga Chocolate Body Butter, a chocolate body butter at £15.99, or the Rose & Geranium version. Our Body Polish Ritual puts all three steps together.

Fresh all day

Vilvah Deo Shots in Lavender & Sage and Rose & Vanilla are a natural deodorant at £9.99 each, and the Deo Shot Kit brings both together. For men, Coach Green Shower Gel and Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza Deodorant Stick add a scented finish that pairs well with your fragrance.

Wind down

anatomē's sleep range includes Relax + Sleep Chamomile Bath Salts, Sleep Oil for Restless Sleep and Somali Frankincense Sleep Pillow Spray, with gift sets such as The Gift of Good Sleep. See the full calm and sleep edit for more ideas. Orders over £40 ship free across the UK.

Perfume in the UK: niche, Arabian and designer

Our perfume edit starts here: 357 authentic scents, from minis at £14.99 to rare extraits, all shipped from our UK base. You will find European fashion houses, Arabian perfumers and niche labels side by side, so it is easy to compare styles and price points in one place.

Designer favourites

Designer names include Calvin Klein Eternity and Defy, Chloé Nomade, DKNY Be Delicious, Burberry, Gucci Bloom and Flora, Bvlgari and Hermès. Fans of Jean Paul Gaultier can pick up Scandal Gold Eau de Parfum, and the Jean Paul perfume line also includes a perfumed shower gel. The Dolce & Gabbana perfume range covers The One for Men, Devotion and K, with gift sets for both.

Arabian and niche

Al Haramain's Amber Oud editions, Hemel, Signature D'orient, Fumeri and Korloff bring rich oud, amber and spice. Signature D'orient Blue, a signature blue scent at £38.99, takes a fresher route. Niche houses include Tiziana Terenzi extraits, Jo Milano, whose Game of Spades Full House is a warm unisex Eau de Parfum, plus Mancera, Montale and Serge Lutens. If you want every oud perfume in one list, browse the oud family or our Arabian perfume edit.

Find your scent

Shop by family to narrow the field: warm amber, woody, floral and fresh. Miniatures, discovery sets and 10ml sprays let you test a scent before committing to a full bottle. Free UK delivery applies to orders over £40.

Natural shampoo, conditioner and hair oil

Find a natural shampoo, conditioner or hair oil from our 29 haircare products by Vilvah and Deyga, with prices from £9.99. These Indian brands work with rice water, goat milk, soy milk, neem and traditional herbs. Swansura is an official UK partner of both, and we ship every order from the UK.

Wash and condition

Vilvah Goat Milk Shampoo is a gentle goat milk shampoo that cleanses without stripping, and pairs with Vilvah Cream Conditioner. Deyga Rice Water Shampoo, the rice water shampoo in our range, is made to improve hair texture and manageability, with Deyga Soy Milk Conditioner as its partner. For flakes, Vilvah Herbal Shampoo and Deyga Anti Dandruff Shampoo sit in our dandruff edit. Choosing a natural shampoo comes down to your scalp, so read each description before you buy.

Oils and treatments

Oiling before you wash is a long Indian tradition. Deyga Hair Growth Oil blends coconut, amla, hibiscus, castor and fenugreek, which makes it a good pick if you want an amla hair oil. Vilvah Hair Growth Oil uses pumpkin seed, kalonji and castor oils. Both are a popular hair growth oil choice for a weekly scalp massage, and you can see more in our hair fall edit. Deyga Premature Greying Hair Oil uses henna and bhringraj. For dry ends, Vilvah Goat Milk Hair Mask and Anti-Frizz Hair Serum add softness and smoothness.

Natural skincare from Deyga, Vilvah and Highborn London

Our natural skincare edit brings together 109 face and lip products from Indian brands Deyga and Vilvah and from luxury English label Highborn London. Prices start at £6.99, so you can try a single cleanser or build a full routine. Swansura is an official UK partner of Deyga and Vilvah, and every order ships from the UK.

Cleanse, tone and moisturise

Start with a wash suited to your skin: Deyga Vitamin C Foaming Face Wash, Vilvah Honey Face Wash or the Fragrance-Free Cream Face Wash. Next comes a face serum, such as Deyga 2% Hyaluronic Acid Serum, Rose Glow Serum or the 10% Vitamin C Face Serum, a vitamin c serum at £16.99. For a moisturiser for dry skin, Deyga Deep Moisturising Face Cream is a rich option, while Highborn London Imperial Moisturiser gives a richer, more luxurious texture. Oilier skin may prefer Deyga Light Moisturising Face Cream, made for oily and normal skin.

Masks, eyes and sun care

Face packs such as Spirulina Matcha Face Pack and Orange & Almond Face Pack Powder are mixed fresh for a weekly mask. Around the eyes, try Deyga Under Eye Mask or Highborn London Imperial Eye Gel, a lightweight alternative to a heavy under eye cream. Finish your morning with Vilvah Skin Finish Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++, a sunscreen spf 50 with a light finish, or browse the full sun care edit.

Not sure where to begin with natural skincare? Shop by concern, from glow and even tone to deep hydration, or pick one of our three-step skincare routines. Spend over £40 and UK delivery is free.
